rationale: First TSFM-embedding trainer; default HPs already hit avg_ann +15.5% with W2 +100% and W6 +115% ann — signal is real but the LR head over-trades W1/W3. Train-mode should sweep head_C (regularization tightness) and embedding_pool to lift WR above 40% on W4/W5/W7 which are sub-margin misses.
